title: 1028: Fix Play and Enter buttons not visible

issues.title: Play and Enter buttons not visible
issues.body:
A change elsewhere in Serge has caused the `Play` and `Enter` buttons to lose their background.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/131320497-7ecc78d4-c205-49c5-8587-0631468c1a04.png)

I don't think we can revert the change since that will probably break something somewhere else.

So, I _guess_ we have to give these buttons an extra class, and to style that class as necessary.

Note: this is also an issue in @lilitkarapetyan 's `Create document` PR:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/131320808-65dbca6f-3ec9-4449-b7c0-92c2d447ec0f.png)

Maybe we need to investigate the cause, and apply a different fix to the change that caused this issue.  That's because there may be other _broken_ places we haven't found yet.  So, it's probably better to find the cause, revert the change, then make a specific change for thing originally being fixed.

Thanks for spotting it @lebaphi
